findings.summary: Spec 'Required acceptance evidence' items 4 and 5 are unsatisfied. Item 4 demands a live drill against the real bus refs endpoint (publish a human work.decision.v1 whose refs carry the actual gate question-note entity id, invoke resume, show decision-to-resume latency under 5s, with real entity/message ids, UTC timestamps, argv, exit status and raw tail); item 5 demands a restart-idempotency drill against the same development/run context. No such record exists in the implement handoff verification_record (which contains only the three dd-acceptance commands), in .dev-dispatch/, or in the development record. The only harness aimed at these drills, scripts/e1_decision_bridge_acceptance.py, states in its own module docstring that both scenarios run 'against a *fake* bus and a *fake* resume owner', which item 4 explicitly excludes ('not a mocked adapter'), and there is no recorded execution of it at all.

_referenced_questions unconditionally treats payload.question_note_id as an answered question and never consults refs_to for it, so any decision carrying that field resolves an owner with no ref-graph verification -- and _stale_reason's 'question is referenced' check is satisfied by the same unverified field. Because the repository's own decision publisher sets payload.question_note_id (supervise/decision_publisher.py:111), the production decision shape short-circuits the very endpoint this change exists to adopt: a live drill per spec item 4 could pass without GET /v1/entities/<id>/refs ever being called. The inline path also has no test; the decision() helper in tests never sets payload.question_note_id, so all 13 resolver tests exercise only the refs_to path.

Product-tree equality between a48b52d6a31f2e10bf65898a171113cfbc7dc676 and 4a17d9b2a87c91833d96b32ac2dd5e8fdb87f697 outside .dev-dispatch could not be checked mechanically: this reviewer has file-inspection tools only and executed no git command. Reviewed instead against the worktree contents. Related record discrepancy, not a defect in the change: the implement handoff reports work_head_commit ea02577c7be430e448a926d0bc1f02feff43cee8, while the dispatch context labels a48b52d6a31f2e10bf65898a171113cfbc7dc676 as the product commit -- consistent with a48b52d6 being the materializer's metadata-only commit stacked on ea02577c.

The code change itself is minimal and correct against the endpoint contract established from repository code: BusClient.refs_to (client.py:163-166), Board.decision_for (board.py:347), the resolver's reverse look-up (resolver.py:91-122) and the bridge's _refs_to seam with getattr fail-open (bridge.py:279-290) agree on {"refs": [{"message_id", "target_entity"}]}, and test_refs_are_resolved_through_the_real_endpoint (test_decision_bridge.py:294) pins the reverse-refs semantics rather than a mock shape. This finding is informational and is not a reason for the REJECT.
